verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships its own AI product (Visalaw AI), so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question and the axis applies. The probe found llms.txt returning HTTP 404 on visalaw.com, and the pack contains no agent-oriented documentation for either site. The visalaw.ai domain was not probed, which keeps confidence at medium rather than high.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
